exchanges.body: {"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"description":"Create, read and retire short links; visitors are redirected with 302.","title":"urlshort","version":"1"},"servers":[{"url":"/"}],"paths":{"/api/links":{"post":{"description":"Without Idempotency-Key every call creates a new link. With a key, a repeat with the same url within 24 h of the first 201 returns that link (current state); a different url is 422.","operationId":"createLink","parameters":[{"description":"1 to 255 visible ASCII characters; makes a retried create return the first link","in":"header","name":"Idempotency-Key","required":false,"schema":{"type":"string"}}],"requestBody":{"content":{"application/json":{"examples":{"create":{"description":"create","value":{"url":"https://example.com/some/path?q=1"}}},"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/CreateLinkRequest"}}},"required":true},"responses":{"201":{"content":{"application/json":{"examples":{"created":{"description":"created","value":{"code":"Ab3dE9fG","shortUrl":"http://localhost:8080/Ab3dE9fG","url":"https://example.com/some/path?q=1","state":"active","createdAt":"2026-10-03T05:12:42.133Z"}}},"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/LinkResponse"}}},"description":"Created, or replayed for the same key and url","headers":{"Location":{"description":"/api/links/{code}","schema":{"type":"string"},"style":"simple"}}},"400":{"content":{"application/problem+json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail"}}},"description":"Invalid url or Idempotency-Key (errors[] names field and rule), or a body that is not a JSON object"},"413":{"content":{"application/problem+json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail"}}},"description":"Body larger than 16 384 bytes"},"415":{"content":{"application/problem+json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail"}}},"description":"Content-Type is not application/json"},"422":{"content":{"application/problem+json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail"}}},"description":"Idempotency-Key already used with a different url"},"500":{"content":{"application/problem+json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail"}}},"description":"Nothing was stored"}},"summary":"Create a short link for an http(s) URL","tags":["link-controller"]}},"/api/links/{code}":{"delete":{"operationId":"retireLink","parameters":[{"in":"path","name":"code","required":true,"schema":{"type":"string"}}],"responses":{"204":{"description":"Retired"},"404":{"content":{"application/problem+json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail"}}},"description":"No link has this code"},"410":{"content":{"application/problem+json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail"}}},"description":"Already retired"},"500":{"content":{"application/problem+json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail"}}},"description":"Nothing was changed"}},"summary":"Retire a link; visitors then get 410 and the record is link; state is active or retired"},"404":{"content":{"application/problem+json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail"}}},"description":"No link has this code"}},"summary":"Read a link by its code","tags":["link-controller"]}},"/api/links/{code}/stats":{"get":{"operationId":"stats","parameters":[{"in":"path","name":"code","required":true,"schema":{"type":"string"}}],"responses":{"200":{"content":{"application/json":{"examples":{"stats":{"description":"stats","value":{"code":"Ab3dE9fG","totalClicks":6,"clicksPerDay":[{"date":"2026-10-01","clicks":2},{"date":"2026-10-02","clicks":3},{"date":"2026-10-04","clicks":1}],"topReferrers":[{"referrer":"https://a.example","clicks":5}]}}},"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/LinkStats"}}},"description":"Total
